name: Stegopelta
sum: Stegopelta is a struthiosaurin nodosaurid from the Frontier Formation of Wyoming, based on a partial skeleton.
holotype: FMNH UR88, with a maxilla fragment, cervical, dorsal and caudal vertebrae, sacrum and ilia, scapulae, forelimb bones and armour — Belle Fourche Member, Frontier Formation, Wyoming.
biology: Known from a partial skeleton and armour; the sources give no behavioural data.
author: Williston 1905

sources.text: Williston, S.W. 1905. A new armored dinosaur from the Upper Cretaceous of Wyoming. Science 22(564): 503–504. doi:10.1126/science.22.564.503-a
